items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Who are Tony Jefferson on drums, if not Jimmy Wormsworth. On bass is Neal Miner. On bass is Tardo Hammer. On trumpet, it’s Warren Vaché. That’s it.

ctx.x: It’s every Tuesday night. I’ve been there for four years. It’s on 22nd Street between 5th and 6th (avenues) in New York. It’s called the Metropolitan Room. Like I say, I’ve been there four years, and I’m not bored by any means. I love my musicians.
Who are Tony Jefferson on drums, if not Jimmy Wormsworth. On bass is Neal Miner. On bass is Tardo Hammer. On trumpet, it’s Warren Vaché. That’s it.
